newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast distillates firm with heating oil.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast distillates firm with heating oil.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot distillate prices firmed early on a rally in heating oil futures while gasoline was steady, brokers said.
CARB diesel bids and offers rose 0.75 cents to 74.25/75.25 cents a gallon, as the January heating oil contract edged up 0.25 cent a gallon 70.80 cents.
Trade was light as most players stayed out of the market for the holidays.
Low sulphur diesel, dubbed "EPA," saw bids up 1.50 cents and offers one cent higher at 72/72.50 cents.
Jet fuel also rose a cent to 79/80 cents a gallon.
